parts.t: SOUTHSIDE by Georgie award-winning MIRACON! Located on the south slope in Grandview, this 5 bed, 4 bath home offers an open-concept plan with 10 ft ceilings on the main floor! Superior features include a Jenn-Air 5 burner gas range, AC rough-in, gas BBQ outlet, and fireplace. Entertain outdoors on your private covered deck backing onto GREEN SPACE! Close to Grandview Corners shopping, schools, and aquatic centre and quick access to HWY 99 and Vancouver. COSTCO will be opening just 2 minutes away! 5-minute drive from Grandview Heights Secondary School and a 5-minute walk to Edgewood Elementary. RARE 2 BEDROOM LEGAL SUITE with huge AIR BNB POTENTIAL!
